result.topic_en: Gauss describes the method of least squares: a sum of weighted squares of linear functions is reduced, by successive combinations defined through auxiliary angles, to a form in which all terms but one are free of the unknown x.
result.transcription:
Methode der kleinsten Quadrate

$A \ldots\ldots \alpha x +$
$B \ldots\ldots \mathfrak{b} x +$
$B' \ldots\ldots \mathfrak{b}' x +$
$B'' \ldots\ldots \mathfrak{b}'' x +$
etc.
$B^{n-1} \ldots\ldots \mathfrak{b}^{n-1} x +$
} linearische Functionen von $x$ und andern unbekannten Größen

$\Omega = (\lambda A)^2 + (\mu B)^2 + (\mu' B')^2 + (\mu'' B'')^2 + $ etc.
soll ein Minimum werden

Man setze $\frac{\alpha}{\mathfrak{b}} = l$, $\frac{\mu}{\lambda l} = \tang\varphi$, {+$\frac{\mu \tang\varphi}{\lambda} = k$+} [-$\frac{1}{l}\cotang\varphi = k$-],
$A + kB = A'$, $A - lB = C$, $\lambda\cos\varphi = \lambda'$, $\lambda\sin\varphi = \nu$
so ist
$(\lambda' A')^2 + (\nu C)^2 = (\lambda A)^2 + (\mu B)^2$
und $C$ von $x$ frei; der Coefficient von $x$, in $A'$, $= \alpha' = \frac{\alpha}{\cos\varphi^2}$
Fährt man auf dieselbe Art weiter fort, so erhält $\Omega$ die Gestalt

$\Omega = (\nu C)^2 + (\nu' C')^2 + (\nu'' C'')^2 + $ &c. $+ (\nu^{n-1} C^{n-1})^2 + (\mathfrak{b}^n B^n)^2$
wo alle $C$ von $x$ frei sind.

methods.what: Invariance of the sum of two weighted squares under the rotation-like transformation (a Givens-type rotation)
New coefficient of x after the combination
Repeating the step yields a form with only one term depending on x (successive elimination of x)
